user.title: Add a Smart LED display
user.description: Pick the show_frame action of your ESPHome LED panel.

abort.already_configured: This panel is already set up.
abort.no_panels: No ESPHome panel with a show_frame action was found. Flash the smart-led firmware first.

show_text.name: Show text
show_text.description: Draw one line: a left character, a separator and a right character.

display.name: Display
display.description: Which Smart LED display. Optional when only one is set up.

line.name: Line
line.description: Top or bottom half of the screen.

left.name: Left
left.description: One character. Empty leaves it blank.

separator.name: Separator
separator.description: One character between left and right. A space leaves it blank.

right.name: Right
right.description: One character. Empty leaves it blank.

color.name: Color
color.description: Colour for all three slots: a name, hex like #FF8000, or [r, g, b].

left_color.name: Left color
left_color.description: Overrides the colour of the left character.

separator_color.name: Separator color
separator_color.description: Overrides the colour of the separator.

right_color.name: Right color
right_color.description: Overrides the colour of the right character.

clear.name: Clear
clear.description: Blank one line or the whole screen.

display.name: Display
display.description: Which Smart LED display. Optional when only one is set up.
